Marisol (People Ops): Quick question - Priya (incoming PM) is remote in Portland and her passport expires in 5 months. She can't get to a Portland notary until next week. Can we still complete I-9 within 3 days?

Ken (HR): Remote I-9 allowed with authorized notary and e-docs, but we need originals within 3 business days for retention. If originals delayed >3 days payroll flags may delay first paycheck.

Priya (New Hire): I can do a video notary session tomorrow morning, but mailing originals will be slower. Any recommended couriers?

Sam (IT): Laptop readiness note - we can hold build until onboarding confirms address. If you need same-day pickup at the hub (SF) we can tag it for express pickup. Ship command: `shipctl order --user priya.k --model thinkpad --label ONBOARD_EXPRESS`

Marisol (People Ops): Proposed flow: 1) Priya books a remote notary (we'll accept certified e-notary PDF plus video recording). 2) Courier scheduled from Portland to SF for originals, marked "Onboarding - high priority". 3) Payroll notified of temporary withholding status until originals received. 4) Benefits email goes out on day 1 regardless.

Ken (HR): Confirming: payroll will set pay hold flag OFF once originals scanned and uploaded to HRIS. If courier ETA >5 business days, we might need a short pay delay. I'll escalate if needed. Also note: tax state will be Oregon unless employee elects different home address.

Priya (New Hire): I've booked a 9am notary slot with NotaryNow (video). Courier preference: USPS Priority or DHL? I prefer DHL.

CourierBot: New ticket created #ONB-5021; carrier=DHL; pickup window Thu 10:00-12:00. ETA to SF 2 business days. Tracking: https://dhl.example/track/ONB5021

Marisol (People Ops): Great — please upload notarized PDF to the secure intake link: https://onboard.redwood/secure-upload/ONB-5021. Priya once CourierBot delivers please DM me the tracking so I can mark "documents received" in Greenhouse.

Sam (IT): Priya - once you upload and confirm address I'll push laptop build. We can pre-provision VPN certs but you'll need MFA setup on first login.

Priya (New Hire): Uploaded notarized doc. DHL pickup scheduled Thu 10:30. Thanks everyone.

Ken (HR): Background check completed (clear). I've unflagged benefits hold. Benefits enrollment email should arrive within 30 minutes.

Marisol (People Ops): Closing loop - laptop build ordered, benefits link sent, payroll notified of temporary status. Follow-up: once originals arrive we'll close the I-9 step. :party-parrot:
